notes.title: Open ongoing alpha testing of The Seven Spells of Destruction
notes.content:
This game is currently in free open alpha.

If you want to take part, you should come to [url=https://discord.gg/brainbox]the official brainbox.cc discord[/url] where you can find further information!

[b]All are welcome[/b], the only thing I ask is that you actually do test the game, and test it as we add new features, artwork, music, or whatever, and that you keep informed of the project via the discord. [i]We want your feedback[/i]! All it will take is [b]a few minutes of your time[/b] each week, unless you really get into the game as it develops (then that's all good too).

[u]Please help make this game something special and take part today![/u]
